nativeBaseline.reference: native radio inputs in an independently named group

library: Maintain a distinct group name, one selected value, native radio semantics and non-color selected indicators.
consumer: Author the group name, item names and meaningful rating scale.

notes: React and Vue generate independent native radio names unless a form name is authored. Angular requires a root name; Web and Elements use authored native names.
Group labels are authored; explicit or generated numeric item labels support localization. Filled and empty glyphs distinguish state without color.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
